sections.title: Growth and flowers
sections.text: White clover is a creeping perennial. Its runners root at the nodes, making a mat about 10–15 cm tall or less and spreading at least 30 cm. The three leaflets often bear a pale mark; globular flower heads are white, sometimes tinged pink.

sections.title: Food
sections.text: Leaves, stems and flowers are edible; young leaves are used raw or cooked, and flowers can be dried for tea. The plate correctly shows both the creeping, rooting runners and white flower heads.
